description: Feature schema for NYC 311 next-year complaint-count forecasting. The full model input vector is built by concatenating count features, trend features, and the decoded embedding vector in the exact order listed below.

invalid_zip_examples.note: All invalid or missing ZIP codes are marked as 'MISSING' and excluded from embedding records.

cleaning_rules.raw_data_policy: Source data is never modified. All cleaning is performed by a reproducible script.
cleaning_rules.notes: Rules I wrote based on instructions from Kevin.

zipcode.description: Incident ZIP code where the complaint was reported.
rules: Mark invalid or missing ZIP codes as 'MISSING'.
Exclude rows where zipcode is 'MISSING' from embedding records.
Convert to lowercase for comparison and matching purposes.
Collapse internal whitespace to a single space.
Apply the approved alias mapping to produce the final canonical value.
Keep the NYC Open Data raw label for categories without an approved alias.
Do not merge aliases unless explicitly approved by the data steward.

complaint_count.description: Annual count of complaints for the ZIP + complaint-type + year key.

rules: After standardization, remove exact duplicate rows keyed by (zipcode, complaint_type, year).
Keep the first occurrence and discard subsequent duplicates.
Flag counts above the 99th percentile in the coverage report for human review.
Document any flagged outliers in the release notes.

current.description: Complaint count for the source year.

lag_1.description: Complaint count for source_year - 1. If missing, imputed with current.

lag_2.description: Complaint count for source_year - 2. If missing, imputed with lag_1.

trend_features.description: Derived from counts in the exact order [current - lag_1, lag_1 - lag_2, mean(current, lag_1, lag_2)].

embedding.description: Decoded and denormalized embedding vector appended after trend features.
embedding.generation_method: Deterministic hash embedding of standardized zipcode and complaint_type.

imputation.description: When historical counts are missing, lag values are forward-filled: lag_2 uses lag_1, lag_1 uses current.

record_format.normalized_complaint_type_hash: First 16 characters of SHA-256 of standardized complaint_type
